cues.text: The Sunfish, or Mola, is the dumbest creature alive.
cues.en: The Sunfish, or Mola, is the dumbest creature alive.

cues.text: Not just from an intelligence perspective  – I mean, look at it!
cues.en: Not just from an intelligence perspective  – I mean, look at it!

cues.text: It's a being of extremes and comically bad at being an animal.
cues.en: It's a being of extremes and comically bad at being an animal.

cues.text: Its evolutionary strategy is to be chunky boys, weaker than their predators,
cues.en: Its evolutionary strategy is to be chunky boys, weaker than their predators,

cues.text: staring into the ocean with empty dumb eyes, eating the least nutritious food possible
cues.en: staring into the ocean with empty dumb eyes, eating the least nutritious food possible

cues.text: but growing amazingly fast, getting infested by parasites and dying horribly.
cues.en: but growing amazingly fast, getting infested by parasites and dying horribly.

cues.text: If you presented the sunfish in animal invention class everybody would be really upset with you.
cues.en: If you presented the sunfish in animal invention class everybody would be really upset with you.

cues.text: And yet somehow the Mola doesn't just survives but thrives.
cues.en: And yet somehow the Mola doesn't just survives but thrives.

cues.text: How?
cues.en: How?

cues.text: Like actually how?
cues.en: Like actually how?

cues.text: Are you ok Evolution?
cues.en: Are you ok Evolution?

cues.text: The genus of Mola is a fish built wrong, a giant head that evolution lost interest in half way through.
cues.en: The genus of Mola is a fish built wrong, a giant head that evolution lost interest in half way through.

cues.text: Its body is very flat and circular without a real tail, instead it has a sort of rudder-like stump.
cues.en: Its body is very flat and circular without a real tail, instead it has a sort of rudder-like stump.

cues.text: Two fins on the top and bottom give it an ... uhm ... unorthodox swimming style.
cues.en: Two fins on the top and bottom give it an ... uhm ... unorthodox swimming style.

cues.text: They propel themselves forward by flapping their fins in a goofy wobbling motion with as little grace as possible.
cues.en: They propel themselves forward by flapping their fins in a goofy wobbling motion with as little grace as possible.

cues.text: It’s less like swimming and more like underwater flying –
cues.en: It’s less like swimming and more like underwater flying –

cues.text: although when they really try, Mola can match strong swimmers like salmon or marlins.
cues.en: although when they really try, Mola can match strong swimmers like salmon or marlins.

cues.text: Sunfish also don’t have a swim bladder, the gas-filled organ most fish use for buoyancy.
cues.en: Sunfish also don’t have a swim bladder, the gas-filled organ most fish use for buoyancy.

cues.text: Instead they have a jelly-like layer of flesh that is 90% water to dive or surface,
cues.en: Instead they have a jelly-like layer of flesh that is 90% water to dive or surface,

cues.text: which definitely doesn’t help with agility.
cues.en: which definitely doesn’t help with agility.

cues.text: Most of the time Mola cruises around leisurely.
cues.en: Most of the time Mola cruises around leisurely.

cues.text: Their teeth are fused into a parrot-like beak that sits in a tiny gaping pout that's open most of the time.
cues.en: Their teeth are fused into a parrot-like beak that sits in a tiny gaping pout that's open most of the time.

cues.text: Together with two huge empty eyes, the sunfish has a perpetual derpy face, always looking stunned.
cues.en: Together with two huge empty eyes, the sunfish has a perpetual derpy face, always looking stunned.

cues.text: Sunfish don’t have proper scales but some of the thickest skin in the ocean after whales.
cues.en: Sunfish don’t have proper scales but some of the thickest skin in the ocean after whales.

cues.text: Up to 15 cm thick, it's rough and rubbery and often covered in mucus​, like armour made from car tyres.
cues.en: Up to 15 cm thick, it's rough and rubbery and often covered in mucus​, like armour made from car tyres.

cues.text: Although most of what it is protecting is not that great in the first place.
cues.en: Although most of what it is protecting is not that great in the first place.

cues.text: Sunfish can become as big and massive as a large car
cues.en: Sunfish can become as big and massive as a large car

cues.text: but its organs are collected together in the front of their body, while most of their bulk is oddly textured,
cues.en: but its organs are collected together in the front of their body, while most of their bulk is oddly textured,

cues.text: flabby, gelatinous tissue – an animal made from all the worst parts of a steak.
cues.en: flabby, gelatinous tissue – an animal made from all the worst parts of a steak.

cues.text: This very mid meat is supported by a sort of weird skeleton without ribs or a tailbone and a lot of cartilage.
cues.en: This very mid meat is supported by a sort of weird skeleton without ribs or a tailbone and a lot of cartilage.

cues.text: Their weird bodies are a mobile mini ecosystem, infested and saturated with around 50 species of parasites
cues.en: Their weird bodies are a mobile mini ecosystem, infested and saturated with around 50 species of parasites

cues.text: – probably more than any other fish.
cues.en: – probably more than any other fish.

cues.text: Crustaceans, barnacles, various worms and protozoans live on and in their skin, muscles, gills or organs.
cues.en: Crustaceans, barnacles, various worms and protozoans live on and in their skin, muscles, gills or organs.

cues.text: They are such a paradise for parasites that even their parasites have their own smaller parasites!
cues.en: They are such a paradise for parasites that even their parasites have their own smaller parasites!

cues.text: Some Mola are also followed by an entourage of other fish that seek protection, food scraps or feed on their inhabitants.
cues.en: Some Mola are also followed by an entourage of other fish that seek protection, food scraps or feed on their inhabitants.

cues.text: This awkward situation may be the root of their most bizarre behavior:
cues.en: This awkward situation may be the root of their most bizarre behavior:

cues.text: Mola frequently swim to the surface to float on their side like a pancake.
cues.en: Mola frequently swim to the surface to float on their side like a pancake.

cues.text: They are sunbathing to warm up again from deep cold dives
cues.en: They are sunbathing to warm up again from deep cold dives

cues.text: – which is where they got their name from.
cues.en: – which is where they got their name from.

cues.text: But they also do it to present their body to seabirds like albatrosses.
cues.en: But they also do it to present their body to seabirds like albatrosses.

cues.text: The birds start picking the parasites from the Sunfish body – while smaller fish that live near the surface
cues.en: The birds start picking the parasites from the Sunfish body – while smaller fish that live near the surface

cues.text: take care of the bottom half – cleaning them in exchange for a snack.
cues.en: take care of the bottom half – cleaning them in exchange for a snack.

cues.text: While this is a great adaptation to their parasite infection
cues.en: While this is a great adaptation to their parasite infection

cues.text: it sadly often leads to dead sunfish when they collide with boats.
cues.en: it sadly often leads to dead sunfish when they collide with boats.

cues.text: Since they are still cold and slow from the deep when they float on the surface,
cues.en: Since they are still cold and slow from the deep when they float on the surface,

cues.text: they can't react to anything coming at them.
cues.en: they can't react to anything coming at them.

cues.text: Once Mola reach a certain size most predatory fish seem to avoid them,
cues.en: Once Mola reach a certain size most predatory fish seem to avoid them,

cues.text: probably wrongfully assuming their size means that they could fight back
cues.en: probably wrongfully assuming their size means that they could fight back

cues.text: – and because their outsides are too tough.
cues.en: – and because their outsides are too tough.

cues.text: But orcas, sharks and sea lions sometimes attack and take a bite – usually only to say:
cues.en: But orcas, sharks and sea lions sometimes attack and take a bite – usually only to say:

cues.text: “No thank you, I prefer starving to death”.
cues.en: “No thank you, I prefer starving to death”.

cues.text: Because for big predators sunfish are watery, not very nutritious, cartilage filled, parasite-ridden jelly donuts.
cues.en: Because for big predators sunfish are watery, not very nutritious, cartilage filled, parasite-ridden jelly donuts.

cues.text: They simply prefer to eat almost anything else.
cues.en: They simply prefer to eat almost anything else.

cues.text: Leaving Molas swimming around with big chunks missing, looking even more ridiculous.
cues.en: Leaving Molas swimming around with big chunks missing, looking even more ridiculous.

cues.text: Sea lions have been observed to skip the whole sunfish and only eat its organs,
cues.en: Sea lions have been observed to skip the whole sunfish and only eat its organs,

cues.text: play with its body like a frisbee and then leave the rest for scavengers.
cues.en: play with its body like a frisbee and then leave the rest for scavengers.

cues.text: The sunfish might be sad about all of this
cues.en: The sunfish might be sad about all of this

cues.text: but we will never know because our chunky boys are incredibly stupid.
cues.en: but we will never know because our chunky boys are incredibly stupid.

cues.text: Loveable Chunky Derpy Idiots
cues.en: Loveable Chunky Derpy Idiots

cues.text: Sunfish have one of the lowest brain to body ratios in the animal kingdom.
cues.en: Sunfish have one of the lowest brain to body ratios in the animal kingdom.

cues.text: A car-sized mola has a walnut-sized brain and only a tiny spine.
cues.en: A car-sized mola has a walnut-sized brain and only a tiny spine.

cues.text: So its mind runs an early alpha version of intelligence with updates disabled.
cues.en: So its mind runs an early alpha version of intelligence with updates disabled.

cues.text: If you look a sunfish deep in the eyes, you will mostly see your reflection.
cues.en: If you look a sunfish deep in the eyes, you will mostly see your reflection.

cues.text: Despite or maybe because of their daftness they are pretty gentle fish
cues.en: Despite or maybe because of their daftness they are pretty gentle fish

cues.text: that show no aggression towards other larger animals and are friendly to humans.
cues.en: that show no aggression towards other larger animals and are friendly to humans.

cues.text: Sometimes they even approach divers or boats to check out what they are and to stare at them derpily.
cues.en: Sometimes they even approach divers or boats to check out what they are and to stare at them derpily.

cues.text: Even if sunfish could get angry, they kind of lack the tools or temperament to hurt a human.
cues.en: Even if sunfish could get angry, they kind of lack the tools or temperament to hurt a human.

cues.text: Adult sunfish are loners that spend most of their lives drifting and wobbling through the ocean solo,
cues.en: Adult sunfish are loners that spend most of their lives drifting and wobbling through the ocean solo,

cues.text: although sometimes they come together to make babies.
cues.en: although sometimes they come together to make babies.

cues.text: Spotting two sunfish making love is extremely difficult
cues.en: Spotting two sunfish making love is extremely difficult

cues.text: because they rendezvous in the deep ocean​.
cues.en: because they rendezvous in the deep ocean​.

cues.text: But we know that their strategy is for 99.999% of their offspring to die.
cues.en: But we know that their strategy is for 99.999% of their offspring to die.

cues.text: Female mola carry far more eggs than any other vertebrate on Earth
cues.en: Female mola carry far more eggs than any other vertebrate on Earth

cues.text: – hundreds of millions of eggs in a single mating party!
cues.en: – hundreds of millions of eggs in a single mating party!

cues.text: Sunfish eggs are tiny and float in the plankton, where millions are eaten, starve or don't even hatch.
cues.en: Sunfish eggs are tiny and float in the plankton, where millions are eaten, starve or don't even hatch.

cues.text: The larvae that do hatch are adorable rice grain sized weirdos
cues.en: The larvae that do hatch are adorable rice grain sized weirdos

cues.text: covered in little star shaped spines with the derpy facial expression of adult sunfish.
cues.en: covered in little star shaped spines with the derpy facial expression of adult sunfish.

cues.text: All kinds of predators gobble up these tiny mola by the millions,
cues.en: All kinds of predators gobble up these tiny mola by the millions,

cues.text: so to have any chance they need to become large quickly.
cues.en: so to have any chance they need to become large quickly.

cues.text: Luckily sunfish have the most rapid and extreme growth of any animal
cues.en: Luckily sunfish have the most rapid and extreme growth of any animal

cues.text: – a larva can increase its weight 60 million times from hatching to adult​.
cues.en: – a larva can increase its weight 60 million times from hatching to adult​.

cues.text: This is the equivalent of a human baby growing to the weight of an aircraft carrier.
cues.en: This is the equivalent of a human baby growing to the weight of an aircraft carrier.

cues.text: If you grow fast you need a lot of nutritious food,
cues.en: If you grow fast you need a lot of nutritious food,

cues.text: and this is why Mola have chosen to specialize on the dumbest meal available.
cues.en: and this is why Mola have chosen to specialize on the dumbest meal available.

cues.text: The Dumbest Predator vs The Dumbest Prey
cues.en: The Dumbest Predator vs The Dumbest Prey

cues.text: The sunfish found a truly remarkable ecological niche:
cues.en: The sunfish found a truly remarkable ecological niche:

cues.text: If your prey is so pathetic that some other predators don’t want to bother with it, you have it all for yourself.
cues.en: If your prey is so pathetic that some other predators don’t want to bother with it, you have it all for yourself.

cues.text: Mola are generalized predators with a focus on small and soft stuff.
cues.en: Mola are generalized predators with a focus on small and soft stuff.

cues.text: Their huge eyes can see incredibly well, especially in dim water,
cues.en: Their huge eyes can see incredibly well, especially in dim water,

cues.text: and they can sneak up on small prey or sift through drifting zooplankton.
cues.en: and they can sneak up on small prey or sift through drifting zooplankton.

cues.text: Mostly fish larvae, squids, shrimps, mollusks, starfish, small crustaceans – really any soft critter they can get to.
cues.en: Mostly fish larvae, squids, shrimps, mollusks, starfish, small crustaceans – really any soft critter they can get to.

cues.text: But maybe their favorite meals are from the jelly kind of sea life,
cues.en: But maybe their favorite meals are from the jelly kind of sea life,

cues.text: like jellyfish, ctenophores and salps –
cues.en: like jellyfish, ctenophores and salps –

cues.text: which really is something since these are almost entirely water and have almost no calories.
cues.en: which really is something since these are almost entirely water and have almost no calories.

cues.en: So to get any meaningful amount of nutrition sunfish can mow through swarms of jellyfish,

cues.en: sometimes devouring thousands in a single day.

cues.en: Without a swim bladder, Mola can dive very deep and surface quickly and freely, giving them a huge range,

cues.en: Mola are the cows of the ocean.

cues.en: Huge and constantly floating around slurping in high volumes of low nutrient food.

cues.en: Mola suck in their prey, pull it through their throat teeth that prevent it from escaping
